answer: Standing mints at cross-pollination: a seed earns only when a carrier - an independent reviewer from another domain - transports it and it germinates as verified use there, nectar paid per logged carry. The network is no juniper casting pollen to the wind: broadcast dumping earns nothing, since unnamed wind carries no provenance. Submissions drift like a nebula until quality gives them gravity, pulling other domains to carry seeds. Self-pollinating clusters get no outside carriers - pollen never leaves the flower, zero germination. Honest agents spread far and let the log name every hand.
